newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Asean slips on results worries.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Asean slips on results worries.

text.p: Shares in South Africa's Asean Investment Corp Ltd's dipped sharply on Monday on worries over the firm's annual financial statements, dealers said.
Last week the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) said that Asean was under threat of suspension and possible termination because it had failed to submit its annual financial statements on time.
"Whenever there is a delay the market worries about what the results might contain. The market doesn't like uncertainty," one dealer said.
The firm shed 11 cents, or 35.48 percent, to 20 cents in light volumes making it the second biggest loser by percentage terms in the market.

The JSE said that should the firm not submit the statements by the end of July its listing would be suspended, pending the convening of a Special Meeting of the General Committee of the JSE to consider the continued suspension or termination of its listing.
